build_autoencoder_kl_qwenimage: build a QwenImage VAE model to encode and decode video frames into latent representations
encode_video_with_qwenimage_vae: encode a batch of video frames into latent distributions using AutoencoderKLQwenImage
decode_latents_with_qwenimage_vae: decode latent vectors back into video frames using AutoencoderKLQwenImage
enable_tiled_vae_decoding: enable tiled encoding and decoding on AutoencoderKLQwenImage to process large videos with reduced memory
review_causal_conv3d_caching: review the QwenImageCausalConv3d layer and its feature caching mechanism for causal temporal convolution
